account_type.public_subtitle: Your content is visible to everyone.

account_type.public_bullet_4: You appear in "Suggested for you" feeds for non-followers.
account_type.public_bullet_5: Your hangouts show up on the public map.
account_type.private_bullet_1: Follow requests stay pending until you approve or reject each one.
account_type.private_bullet_2: Non-followers only see your name, photo, bio, and counts — no posts or hangouts. They see a "Follow to view content" message.

account_type.private_bullet_4: Your posts and hangouts don't appear in "Suggested for you" feeds for non-followers.
account_type.private_bullet_5: Your personal hangouts don't show up on the public map.
account_type.info_note: In both modes: existing followers stay as-is, blocks override everything, and places are always public (so messaging a place isn't affected).
